agents.label: Arena Agent Mode
agents.notes: Use repository connection, generated files, prompt handoff or downloadable package; no public local skill installer documented.

agents.label: Claude.ai / Claude cloud
agents.notes: Cloud sessions use account-enabled skills or repository skills; local ~/.claude state does not transfer automatically.

agents.label: Claude Code
agents.notes: Native skills, plugins, hooks, agents and MCP; Claude-specific extensions stay outside the portable core.

agents.label: Hermes Agent
agents.notes: Supports portable Agent Plugins and native Python plugins; native packages may register tools, hooks and skills.

agents.label: OpenClaw
agents.notes: Workspace skills have high precedence; native plugins and Agent Plugins bundles are separate formats.

agents.label: OpenCode
agents.notes: Also discovers .opencode/skills and Claude-compatible skill locations; MCP is local or remote.

agents.label: Codex CLI / IDE
agents.notes: AGENTS.md and Agent Skills are first-class; agents/openai.yaml is optional UI and dependency metadata.

agents.label: ChatGPT / ChatGPT Work
agents.notes: Use a skill or OpenAI plugin; app availability, plan, workspace and admin permissions apply.

agents.label: Mistral Vibe CLI
agents.notes: Agent Skills, AGENTS.md, custom agents and tool permissions; trust folders affect project discovery.

agents.label: Google Antigravity CLI / IDE
agents.notes: Plugins may include skills, agents, rules, hooks and MCP; native paths are not identical to Agent Skills paths.

agents.label: ZCode by Z.AI
agents.notes: Supports external skill import and native MCP management; plugin skill layout is flat.

agents.label: DeepSeek Harness / DSH
agents.notes: Everything-is-a-plugin architecture; pin DSH versions and keep native Cordis code in the adapter.

agents.label: Generic Agent Skills client
agents.notes: Best-effort target for clients implementing Agent Skills or Agent Plugins; verify discovery and permissions.
